Inputs: target = 58, bar = 20, max plates per side = 4.

map.算例（目标 58 kg / 杆 20 kg / 每侧 4 片）: Example (58 kg target / 20 kg bar / 4 plates per side)
Per-side target = (58 − 20) ÷ 2 = 19 kg. Greedy selection gives 15 + 2.5 + 1.25 = 18.75 kg (3 plates, within the 4-per-side cap); actual total = 20 + 2 × 18.75 = 57.5 kg, 0.5 kg below target; the remaining 0.25 kg per side is smaller than the 1.25 kg minimum plate and cannot be loaded.
